versions.subject: refactor: curl rules refactored
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\curl.exe'
    - Product: 'The curl executable'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -O'
        - ' -o '
        - '--remote-name'
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: Image="*\\curl.exe" OR Product="The curl executable" CommandLine IN ("* -O*", "* -o *", "*--remote-name*")
